{{Infobox quest |icon = |image =Gunsmith16Banner.png |location = |given by =[[Mechanic]] |LL requirement = |LL quests = |previous =[[Gunsmith Master - Part 8]] |leads to =[[Gunsmith Master - Part 10]] |related = |related2 = |reqkappa =Yes }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Dialogue== {{quote|What do you think, how much does human life cost? Not much, I guess. But what’s even more surprising for me, it’s the contemporary art market. The value of art pieces by renowned artists grows every year. They are definitely talented, but the more you look at it, the more it seems that anything can be art. It can be a Rothko painting, a displaced urinal, or a bunch of garbage. However, in my opinion, the most amazing pieces of art are weapons, starting from the melee - which is already universally recognized as such and can be found in many museums - to an old AK or M4, which are beautiful as they are. But a weapon only transcends to true art when it becomes unique, one-of-a-kind, in the hands of someone who knows how to use it, who modifies it for his own needs, creating a masterpiece worthy of being displayed in the best of museums. Bring me one such masterpiece, an M4A1 with a KAC QDSS NT-4 (FDE) silencer, Alexander Arms MK10 rifle-length handguard, REAP-IR thermal scope, and a 60-round magazine. Ergonomics should be not less than 40, the recoil sum less than 280, and the weight of 5 kg or less.}} ==Objectives== * Modify an [[M4A1]] to comply with the given specifications ==Rewards== * +28,000 [[EXP]] * 275,000 Roubles ** 288,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 316,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * 1× [[Magazine case]] {{quote|Makes me want to put it on a showcase display. Masterful work, it truly did turn out to be a masterpiece.}} ==Guide== [[M4A1]] specifications: *60 Durability *40 or more ergonomics *280 or less recoil *5 kg or less in weight *A magazine with a capacity of at least 60 *[[KAC QDSS NT4 5.56x45 sound suppressor (FDE)]] *[[AR-15 Alexander Arms MK10 rifle length handguard]] *[[Trijicon REAP-IR thermal scope]] ==Builds== '''This is one example of many possible configurations.''' ====Notes:==== * This build is based on a standard [[M4A1]] from [[Peacekeeper]] LL3. * The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
